title: The Empty Chair in the Circle Game
youtube_title: The Empty Chair in the Circle Game | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Dori is just outside the fun, close to a circle game with one child left on the step. Nils changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Dori has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
